source.required_status: clean tracked and untracked worktree before and after execution

purpose: Full-scale operational verification of the Japanese three-model 24-agent by 60-step envelope.
claim_boundary: Engineering operation only. The run is permanently ineligible for research pooling or behavioral inference and must never be promoted into a formal research run.

pass: run status is completed, aborted is false, and completed_steps is 60
exactly 2880 LLM attempts exist with the registered phase and model coverage
all 24 Phase 1 attempt rows for each step precede that step's 24 Phase 3 attempt rows
every attempt has HTTP 200, finish_reason stop, valid transport, valid JSON syntax, and valid phase schema
transport, syntax, and schema failure counters are zero
every response has Japanese-script text in its explanation or memory fields
no response terminates because of the 256-token limit
maximum recorded prompt tokens remain below the 4096-token model context envelope
publication scan finding count is zero and runtime binding values are absent
all server process groups stop and all selected GPUs are released
source HEAD remains the exact registered commit with an empty Git status
decision_rules.fail: Any unmet pass rule fails the operation. Preserve every completed, aborted, negative, or contradictory run and never reuse its run ID.

analysis_restrictions: Inspect only operational integrity, coverage, response validity, token envelope, and cleanup fields for this gate decision.
Do not use model actions, messages, explanation text, or behavioral metrics to select or tune a later formal research condition.
Do not pool this run with any later research-eligible run.
Reserve seed 2403 for engineering use only.
